  "meta_commentary": "## Execution Guidance\n\n**Architecture:** This plan threads a new `variant_id` field through an existing pipeline: client selection \u2192 edge function \u2192 task creation \u2192 task completion \u2192 timeline placement. The key insight is that the repository's variant model means `complete_task` often creates a new `generation_variants` row (not a new generation), so completion-time placement must use the exact variant identity to insert the right asset.\n\n**Critical path:** T1\u2192T2\u2192T3 must land first to establish stable source identity. T4 is a standalone refactor of complete_task's return types. T5 depends on both T3 (for the placement_intent contract) and T4 (for the CompletionAssetRef).
